article.title: GreenCart lifts full-year revenue outlook
article.text: GreenCart Grocers (GRCR) raised its full-year outlook on Thursday, saying it now expects revenue of about $17.2 billion for fiscal 2027, the year ending 30 January 2027, up from the $16.8 billion it guided in March. New stores in the south-west opened ahead of plan. Investors will get updates with the quarterly reports in August and November; the full-year result is published with the fourth-quarter earnings release in mid-March 2027. Shares rose 3%.

article.title: GreenCart guides third-quarter sales below forecasts
article.text: GreenCart Grocers (GRCR) said on Thursday it expects third-quarter revenue of about $4.1 billion, below the $4.3 billion analysts had forecast, as price cuts across its fresh-food ranges weigh on sales. The grocer's fiscal 2027 runs to 30 January 2027; its third quarter covers August to October 2026 and the results are due in late November. Chief financial officer Dana Whitlow said shoppers were trading down to own-label goods faster than the company had planned. Shares fell 4% in early trading. GreenCart did not change its outlook for the full year.

article.title: GreenCart sees second-half profit of about $310 million
article.text: GreenCart Grocers (GRCR) said it expects operating profit of about $310 million for the second half of fiscal 2027, the six months from August 2026 to January 2027, as wage increases and price cuts squeeze margins. Analysts polled before the update had expected about $340 million. The grocer's fiscal year ends on 30 January 2027 and it publishes its full-year results in mid-March. Chief executive Mara Olsen said the company would protect prices on staples through the holiday season.
